rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: AMFI India changed their NAV data URL from www.amfiindia.com to portal.amfiindia.com with a 302 redirect. The httpx client was not following redirects by default.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: 1) Updated AMFI_NAV_URL constant to use portal.amfiindia.com directly, 2) Added follow_redirects=True to httpx.AsyncClient for future-proofing
rca_of_the_issue.verification: NAV refresh now returns 31562 entries and updates 46 mutual fund holdings
